root: ^Here it is. Station ***, one-way ticket. No return.
^Understood. And may I ask the purpose of your journey?
^I am bound for a meeting… though, in truth, it comes many years too late.
^Madam, your ticket expired… seventy years ago.
^Aye. It was purchased long ago. Back when I still believed in a brighter morrow.

s: ^Forgive me, milady, but with an expired ticket, I cannot allow you to proceed with your journey.

c-0: ^That ticket was bought when these very rails were still being forged, young man. Back then, my dreams had yet to be buried beneath dust and silence.
c-1: ^I shall alight at the next station…
